note: Class: countermodel/inconsistency. With the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis of potency (STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY) the thesis leaves nothing in potency, so a moved thing would be moved without potency. Refuted given open premises STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD, STMT-WHAT-IS-BEING-MOVED-TO-R-IS-NOT-YET-R and STMT-WHAT-IS-BEING-MOVED-TO-R-IS-ABLE-TO-BE-R by MEGARIAN-THESIS-ABOLISHES-MOTION (Metaphysics IX.3, 1047a10-17), which does not use the rivalled premise. No refutes relation is recorded while that premise is open (#391: rule (c) does not yet check the premises of a refuting argument).
